accepted_loop_history.reason: Pipelined the multiplier and adder tree into 3 stages to reduce the combinational delay. The parent module dot_0 must be updated to handle the 3-cycle latency of fp4_dot_unit.

Pipelined the FP4 dot product unit into 3 stages by inserting registers after the first and second levels of the FP8 adder tree, and at the final output. This splits the 31.6 ns combinational path into three stages of ~11 ns each, closing timing. The parent module dot_0 must be updated to account for the 3-cycle latency of fp4_dot_0.

This restructures the FP8 adder combinational logic by unifying the normal and subnormal normalization paths, simplifying the alignment shifters into direct 8-way multiplexers, and replacing signed 7-bit exponent arithmetic with 5-bit unsigned logic.
Pipelining the multiplier outputs and each level of the adder tree into 4 stages to break the long combinational path.
